description: REEF3D::CORAL mooring on an FNPF body (Z 40 1, fluid_body): the FNPF 2D box of validation 15 in regular waves, surge, heave and pitch through a planar joint, moored fore by a quasi-static line (elastic catenary with seabed) and aft by a dynamic line (lumped mass); REEF3D_FNPF_6DOF and REEF3D_CORAL (with the line forces) compared.
covers: CORAL mooring quasi_static and dynamic on a fluid body
